verdicts.proof: 4.1.3 (git show 70a94933 reservation_detail_screen.dart:67-89, :220) had _protocolBanner (heading protocolBannerTitle, hidden when res.protocolSigned, state from handoverProtocolStateProvider) opening Routes.protocol. Commit 3e872afe (in main, kiosk 1.2.11) removed it for both looks; current reservation_detail_screen.dart:46-48 only has the comment, and core/router.dart has no protocol route. The only remaining hint is the same in both looks: res_access_codes_card.dart:132-136 (old, amber small text 'protocolFirst') and :98 -> res_codes_v2.dart:120 (v2 sub-line v2UxRpProtocolFirst, warn colour) under an issued motorcycle code of a self-service booking until protocolSigned. Not a v2 regression (v2 equals the current old look), but weaker than 4.1.3: small text only, and only once the motorcycle code is issued. Kiosk enforces protocol_required server-side.
verdicts.fix_idea: No v2 parity fix needed. Optional (both looks, owner decision): show the protocol reminder in the v2 codes tile as a heading line instead of a sub-line.
